Test fixture
============

`bca_fs_2025.pdf` is the audited financial statement of PT Bank Central Asia
Tbk for the year ended 31 December 2025, published by the company on its
investor relations site:

    https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf

It is here so the reader can be tested against a real Indonesian financial
statement rather than a synthetic one. The tests that use it skip themselves
if the file is absent.

The document is the property of its publisher. This is a test fixture for a
tool that reads such documents; it is not a model of any company.
